note: TestRFC6793DecodeFourOctetWhenNegotiated calls ParseASPath and ParseAggregator with fourByte=true and recovers AS 4200000001 from four ASN octets and an 8-octet AGGREGATOR. TestRFC6793DecodeTwoOctetWhenNotNegotiated calls ParseASPath with fourByte=false over the same four ASN octets but a segment count of two, asserting AS 0xFA56 and AS 0xEA01; it refuses the 8-octet AGGREGATOR with ErrInvalidLength and accepts the valid 6-octet AS_TRANS form. These are codec-width assertions; they do not themselves exercise capability negotiation through a session.
